name: marketing-agent
description: A marketing team of subagents (director, competitive intel, SEO/GEO, campaign strategy, content, social, email, creative, paid media, localization, reporting) that dispatches marketing requests to the right specialist and sequences multi-discipline campaigns. The plugin ships agents only; every specialist delegates to dedicated account skills for campaign planning, competitive research, content drafting, brand review, email sequences, SEO auditing, creative production, localization, and reporting instead of duplicating them here.
